# gramlot-examples 0.3.33 — Gallery lessons and reactive charts

- Fundamentals introduces Data, bindings, labels and styles with minimal Python and JavaScript.
- Per-example JSON metadata, searchable tags and Markdown lessons; sample Data companions keep code focused.
- Dedicated checkBoxText, hierarchical checkboxes, grid sets, primary supplier and column/date filters.
- Charts section with simple, time, 3D and map examples; original server-backed sales and geographic reports remain available through their environment.
- Drawing annotations and live audio/system-monitor lessons, using shared components.
- Compact controls, detachable Example/Explanation/Code, remembered lesson view and optional single-page navigation.

Qualification: all 115 Python tests passed. Full JavaScript sweep passed 418 tests with one Drawing initialization finding; that finding was corrected and all 14 affected checks passed. No Invoice application is included.
